newsitem.title: TAIWAN: US firm said planning T$100 bln Taiwan mall completed.
newsitem.headline: US firm said planning T$100 bln Taiwan mall completed.

text.p: Taiwan's United Daily News said on Friday that an unidentified U.S. firm planned to invest T$100 billion (US$3.6 billion) to build a shopping mall complex on reclaimed land near the southern port of Kaohsiung.
Once realised, the project would be the biggest investment by foreigners ever in Taiwan, the mass-circulation paper said.
The United Daily News quoted an unnamed economics ministry official as saying the U.S. firm has contacted the ministry but demanded confidentiality until formally seeking approval.
A spokeswoman in the ministry's public affairs department said she knew nothing of the reported project and declined to comment further.

Taiwan is striving to develop the island as an Asia-Pacific operations hub for multinational firms and envisages Kaohsiung, one of the world's top container ports, becoming a regional transshipment centre.
